description:
Get full description, amenities, access notes, and policies for a unit.

    Args:
        unit: One of "muckle-meadow-pod", "cosie-coorie-pod", "bb".
              For "bb", returns the 4 rooms plus shared amenities.

    Returns:
        {unit, details: {name, type, size_sqm, amenities, rooms?, ...},
         policies, location}.

unit.description: Which WEE WiLDS unit: "muckle-meadow-pod" (Muckle Meadow Glamping Pod), "cosie-coorie-pod" (Cosy Coorie Pod) or "bb" (the B&B, all 4 rooms).
unit.title: Unit

name: get_unit_details

Fact.description: One fact: a short topic and the detail to tell the guest.

RoomDetails.description: One B&B room: facts, FAQs and rating for that room only.

error.description: Present only when the request could not be answered; says why.

facts.description: Facts and amenities for the unit (for "bb", the house as a whole).

location.description: Where WEE WiLDS is and how to get there.

policies.description: Business-wide policies: check-in/out, cancellation, pets, children and the like.

rating.description: Live guest review average and count (for "bb", all four rooms).

url.description: Unit page with the live booking calendar.

valid_units.description: Valid unit slugs, on an unknown unit.
